hook.text: A single user sends 10,000 requests per second to your API. Without limits, they crash everyone's experience.

buildup.text: Rate limiting caps how many requests a client can make in a time window.

discovery.text: Token bucket and sliding window are common algorithms. Each balances burst tolerance and fairness.

twist.text: Distributed rate limiting is hard. Each server must share state or accept some over-counting.

climax.text: Rate limiting protects systems from abuse, bot traffic, and accidental client bugs.

punchline.text: Cap requests to protect everyone's experience.
